title: ChatGPT merges with Codex, adds Work agent and GPT-5.6 for smarter task #AI #
description:
OpenAI has launched a significant update that merges ChatGPT with Codex, introducing three distinct modes on desktop: Chat, Codex, and the new ChatGPT Work. The Chat mode maintains the familiar conversational experience, while Codex continues to serve developers with enhanced capabilities. The new Work mode acts as an intelligent agent that operates across apps and files, maintaining context over hours and driving tasks from goal-setting to completed work. This functionality is powered by the latest GPT 5.6 model, notable for its advanced UI generation, enabling uniquely dynamic AI interface designs. A key innovation is ChatGPT Sites, available in both Codex and Work, which simplifies website deployment by eliminating the need for managing authentication, databases, hosting, or deployment processes. Users can launch live sites with a single click via tagging, providing immediate, shareable URLs. This update enhances ChatGPT's utility in producing practical outputs such as slides, PDFs, and spreadsheets, creating a seamless workflow that moves from initial concept to polished deliverables swiftly and efficiently. The combination of these features highlights a leap forward in AI-assisted productivity tools for both developers and general users. #ChatGPT #OpenAI #Codex
